tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in business related to Development and maintenance of software and data centre management in India for atleast five years as on the last date of submission of bids

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration issued under the Companies Act by a Competent Authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Reputation of Organization / Credibility / Reliability / Industry Standing

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Financial Strength Based on Average annual turnover and Age of the Firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Size of the Firm (No. of IT Professionals and details of the professionals shall be submitted along with proof of current working status). The bidder shall have a minimum of 200 technically qualified employees on its payroll as on the last date of submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A certificate from the authorised signatory of the company, supported by the latest EPF/ ECR return or equivalent records, shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Minimum 5 years of experience in providing IT / ITES outsourcing contracts executed during the last ten years and details of providing such manpower to the Central Government or State Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India
Satisfactory performance certificates from previous/current major clients (Central or State Government) for the last three consecutive years
Average annual turnover shall be not less than Rs.4,00,00,000 (Rupees Four Crores) during the last three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of Company PAN Card, ISO Certificate, ESI, EPF and GST Certificate. Address Proof of office in Bengaluru, Karnataka else bidder shall submit a undertaking that an office shall be established and accessible to KSNDMC throughout the contract period.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: GST, PAN, ESI and EPF registrations

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Company PAN Card, ISO Certificate, ESI, EPF and GST Certificate. Address Proof of office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be blacklisted by Government of Karnataka or its agencies for any reasons whatsoever & The bidder should not be blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices.

The bidder shall possess at least one valid certification from the following: ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO/IEC 27001 or CMMI Maturity Level 5, as applicable to the scope of services. The certificate shall be valid as on the last date of submission of bids and shall remain valid during the contract period, wherever applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annexure 3: Certificate is to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in Data Centre Management, IT Infrastructure Management, Software Application Development / Maintenance, GIS Application Development / Maintenance, Database Administration, Network Administration, DevOps or IT / ITES Managed Services in / within Central Government or State Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies or Government Companies in India.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Details of experience in data centre management

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Single file of all documents to be submitted as technical bid
